pundit.name: Clint Dempsey
pundit.take: **Mustard Boy's Saudi adventure ain't payin' the bills—Zach's gettin' cooked in the standings, and you hate to see it.** Ain't no wins comin' from that Tier 4 desert gamble — oil money don't mean goals, folks. Meanwhile, Gunner, a.k.a. "Bubba G," is sittin' pretty at the top, smilin' like he knew Morocco was his secret weapon all along — boy probably heard it from his barber. With 47 points, he's cruisin' like he's on the Champs-Élysées. Devin "Ghost Pepper" is nippin' at his heels with 42 points, still hot from that big Spain win over Austria. Rafe "The Noisemaker" is down there at fifth — but hey, maybe he's just settin' us all up for an epic comeback with Germany. As for "The Backpass Assassin," Gayden's 31 points are clingier than Jordan to the World Cup which, let's be honest, is a whole mood. But, hey, it's all love — until the cup's in your hands, it's just a grind.
